snippet.title: Conquero - Main Trailer
snippet.description: Conquero is a 3D turn-based strategy game. It aims to provide players with a fast and fun experience. In addition to fast-paced gameplay, players must conquer the right territories at the right time, develop their armies and buildings through research, hire mercenaries and manage resources correctly, and make alliances with the right lords to become the sole leader of the entire map.
